caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Bailey
caseNameFull: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Company of Texas, in Error v. Harry C. Bailey
disposition: Supplemental motion to dismiss or affirm submitted May 15, 1911.
summary: Error to the Court of Civil Appeals for the Fifth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Cecil H. Smith, Mr. James Hagerman and Mr. Joseph M. Bryson for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Joseph W. Bailey, Mr. Rice Maxey and Mr. J. A. L. Wolfe for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed, with costs. Missouri Pacific Ry. Co. v. Mackey, 127 U. S. 205; Minneapolis Ry. Co. v. Herrick, 127 U. S. 210; Chicago &c. R. R. v. Pontius, 157 U. S. 209; Tullis v. Lake Erie & W. Ry., 175 U. S. 348; El Paso & N. E. Ry. v. Gutierrez, 215 U. S. 87; Chicago, B. & Quincy R. R. Co. v. McGuire, 219 U. S. 549, 564.
